message:
We all know that a little preparation can go a long way, especially when it comes to our kids. That’s why we’ve found a fantastic resource that helps teach our little ones about being ready for emergencies in a way that's engaging and fun. 🧒

From interactive activities to important safety information, it empowers them to be part of the conversation and feel more confident. Because who doesn't want to be the gloriously over-prepared parent, right? 

What are some of your favorite ways to involve your kids in preparedness planning?
